verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe deduplication keys that prevent duplicate alerts from creating new alert records while the original is active, and alert grouping that groups related alerts into a single alert group for triage/escalation/attachment to one incident — directly matching the story of one incident paging one human. This is backed by dedicated docs pages with concrete mechanics (dedup key logic, grouping behavior) rather than vague marketing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of dedup accuracy at scale and no detail on configurable grouping rules beyond the basics.
